transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi. Um, I came in because for a really long time now, I’ve just been walking around with this... this flat, heavy feeling. It's like, even when work is going okay or people are being nice to me, I still just feel down. I just feel kind of empty most days, honestly.
How long have you been feeling this way?

Um, it's been going on for about two years and two months now. I think it started right around the time this... this dashboard project put me in the spotlight at work. I've just felt this way ever since then.
Do you find yourself enjoying activities or hobbies that you used to like before you started feeling this way?

Um, I'm not really sure. I haven't really noticed much of a change with that, to be honest. I didn't really have a lot of big hobbies to begin with, so... I can't say for sure if I enjoy things less now than I did before.
Do you feel like you're able to experience pleasure when good things happen to you?

Yeah, um, I think so. Like, if something goes right at work or I get good news, I still feel good about it. I haven't really noticed a problem with that, honestly. It's not like I'm completely numb when good things happen.
Have you noticed any changes in your sleep since you started feeling this way?
Um, no, not really. I mean, my sleep has been pretty much the same as it always is. I haven't noticed any major changes with it since all this started. I just sleep like I normally do.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite since you started feeling this way?
No, not really. My appetite has been pretty normal, I think. I haven't noticed any changes there... I just eat about the same amount as I usually do.
Do you often feel tired or have low energy?

Yeah, I do. Um, usually by the afternoon, I'm just so wiped out. It gets to the point where even doing basic things at work, like fixing a spreadsheet error or finishing up expense paperwork, is just exhausting. Or even trying to get myself to soccer after... it really just feels like I'm dragging my body and my brain through mud.
Do you feel sad most of the time?

Yeah, I do. Honestly, that's kind of why I came in. For a long time now, I've just been walking around with this... flat, heavy feeling. Even when work is going okay or, you know, people are nice to me, I still just feel down. It's like I feel kind of empty most days.
Have you lost interest in things you used to care about?

No, I wouldn't say that. I still care about the things I normally like to do. Like, I still want to play soccer and I still like my hobbies... I still enjoy them when I actually do them. It's not that I've lost interest in anything, it's really just the energy part that makes it hard to get up and go. But the interest itself is definitely still there.
Do you think this feeling of being down and empty is something that affects your daily life most of the day, or is it more intermittent?

I'd say it's most of the day, really. It's not like it comes and goes... it's just kind of always there in the background. Like I wake up with it, and it stays with me while I'm at work, and it's still there when I get home. It's pretty constant.
Have you noticed any significant changes in your weight since you started feeling this way?
No, not really. My weight has stayed pretty much the same. I haven't really gained or lost anything noticeable since this all started.
Have you ever had thoughts about death or dying?

No, I haven't really had any thoughts like that. I mean, I feel down and tired all the time, but it hasn't ever gotten to the point where I'm thinking about death or dying. It's just a constant heavy feeling, but nothing like that.
Would you say that you feel sad, empty, or hopeless most of the day, nearly every day?

Yeah, I would. That's actually why I decided to come in, really. For a long time now I’ve just been walking around with this... flat, heavy feeling. It's like, even when work is going okay or people are nice to me, I still just feel down. I just feel kind of empty most days.
Do you feel like you're unable to find pleasure in things that you used to enjoy?

No, not really. I still enjoy my usual hobbies and stuff. Like, if I'm playing a game or watching a movie, I still get into it and have fun. So I wouldn't say I've lost interest or can't enjoy things... I still like the things I've always liked. It's just that the heavy feeling is always kind of there in the background, or waiting for me when I'm done. But the enjoyment itself hasn't gone away.
Have you had any difficulty concentrating or making decisions since you started feeling this way?

No, I haven't really noticed any issues with that. My focus at work is fine, and I don't feel like I struggle to make decisions or anything. I can still concentrate on what I need to do, it's just... I'm just doing it while feeling down. But the concentration itself is okay.
Have you experienced a significantly depressed mood for most of the day?

Yeah, like I mentioned a minute ago, that's pretty much exactly it. I've just been walking around with this flat, heavy feeling for a long time now. Even when work is going okay or people are being nice to me, I still just feel down and... kind of empty most days. That's really the main reason I decided to come in to see you.
Do you feel like you're less interested in activities that normally bring you pleasure?

I think that's kind of what you asked a minute ago, right? But yeah, no, my interest hasn't really dropped off. I still want to do the things I usually do, like my hobbies and stuff. So I wouldn't say I'm less interested in them.
Are there things that you used to enjoy doing, but now you don't enjoy them as much or at all?
No, not really. I mean, it's pretty much the same as what I just said about my interests. I still get enjoyment out of the things I usually like doing. It hasn't really changed.
Would you say your feelings of sadness, emptiness, or heaviness are mild, moderate, or severe?

I'd say it's moderate. Like I was saying, it's this constant flat, heavy feeling I walk around with. Even when things are fine at work or people are nice, I still just feel down and empty most days. It's not completely debilitating, but it's definitely there, weighing on me.
Do you feel like you're unable to experience pleasure from activities that normally would bring you pleasure?

I feel like we keep coming back to this, but... no. It's pretty much like I was saying before. I can still enjoy things and get pleasure from my normal activities. That part hasn't really been an issue for me.
